one_liner: Brex is a cloud finance and spend-management platform with a broad REST API, an official hosted MCP server in beta, and a documented Composio toolkit.

auth.notes: Customers integrating with their own Brex accounts use scoped bearer tokens created by an account or card admin. Developer partners use OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant when acting on behalf of customers and client credentials grant for the onboarding API. Brex developer support issues partner client IDs and secrets.

access.notes: The documented customer path requires a Brex account, acceptance of the Developer API agreement, and a scoped token created by an account or card admin. The memo does not establish a self-serve credential path for noncustomers or whether obtaining a Brex account requires sales.

api.notes: The public OpenAPI reference covers expenses, budgets and spend limits, team and card management, transactions, accounting, payments, travel, and webhooks. It supports reads and writes, including transaction reporting, vendor management, and virtual card creation.

mcp.notes: Brex hosts the server. An account or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement, and the beta must be enabled in the Brex dashboard. Employees then authorize via OAuth and can use tools allowed by their Brex permissions. The server supports lookups and selected expense edits, but not approvals or card management.

verdict.rationale: The public REST API supports transaction reporting and virtual card issuance, but a Brex account or card admin must create the customer API token. The official MCP beta offers a permission-scoped alternative for supported tasks, but does not support approvals or card management.

evidence.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.

If you are using the onboarding API, you will generate a Client Credentials Grant as there is no existing Brex client involved. For all other APIs, you will implement the Authorization Code Grant, which implements a web-based redirection flow to request permission from the Brex client to access their account.
Please contact our developer support team to be issued a client ID and client secret for partner authentication.
This guide assumes you are a Brex customer with admin access to your dashboard.
Only account or card admins can create API tokens in the dashboard. You can restrict scopes to only allow the functionality you need to access via API.
If your company has not accepted the developer API agreement, please review the terms and conditions. These must be accepted to use the developer API.
Brex is the first fully unified spend platform — with global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay.
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs. All APIs accept and return JSON and require HTTPS.
Trigger vendor payments via ACH, wire, and check based on information in other internal systems so payments are initiated immediately.
Dynamically create virtual cards with spend limits for new employees or vendors.
The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp and supports any MCP-compatible client.
An account admin or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement in **Settings → Developer**.
Go to **Settings → Beta features** in the Brex Dashboard and select **Brex in AI assistants**. Once enabled, all users in your Brex account can connect to the MCP server with their own credentials.
Any employee can authorize via OAuth and access tools based on their Brex capabilities.

The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.
Your Brex permissions carry over; you only see and modify what you're authorized to. Actions like approvals and card management are not yet available via MCP.
Brex provides corporate credit cards, spend management, and financial tools tailored for startups and tech businesses to optimize cash flow, accounting, and growth
Only account or card admins can create API tokens in the dashboard.
Access your Brex transactions to build reports with the information that matters most to you with our transactions API.
Onboard Brex users and issue virtual cards with custom limits from anywhere, whether your CLI or spreadsheets, using our team API.
